label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 025 ]

blocks.text: It is surprising how many times our feelings of despair and anger can be eased if we act instead of just thinking over problems. Play and work are health actions, relieving the tensions produced by our emotional upsets. Play is physically restful and relieves tensions as we share our emotions with others. Work, too, is an effective means of working off anger and using overflowing energy. Sometimes, ideas come as we begin to act. Action relieves tensions and sets us free.
